api.title: AI service (OpenAI-compatible)
api.hint: Enter your AI service account here. The chat and every other AI feature runs on it.
api.priceCurrencyHint: This model is billed in a different currency on each platform. Select the currency of the platform the API key belongs to, so the spending page matches the bill.

testResult.badUrl: The service address is not a valid web address. It has to start with https://, for example https://api.deepseek.com.
testResult.offline: There is no network connection right now. Check that this device is online, then check whether the internet switch below is turned off.
testResult.timeout: The provider did not respond. The connection may be slow; try again later.
testResult.blockedByBrowser: The browser could not reach this service and gave no reason. Check that this device is online; if it still fails, the provider most likely does not allow web pages to connect directly, so a different provider or the desktop edition will work.
testResult.unreachable: Could not reach this service. Check the service address for a mistake, or try again later.
testResult.unauthorized: The provider reports that this key cannot be used. Copy the API key again from the provider's website.
testResult.insufficientBalance: This account has no credit left. Add funds on the provider's website, then try again.
testResult.notFound: There is no AI service at that address. Check whether the end of the address is missing a segment or has one too many, such as /v1.
testResult.rateLimited: The provider reports that requests are currently too frequent. Try again in a minute or two.
testResult.badRequest: The provider did not accept this request. The most common cause is a mistyped model name, which can be checked against the provider's documentation.
testResult.serverError: Something went wrong on the provider's side, not in these settings. Try again later.

api.priceOverrideHint: Use these when the built-in price list does not contain the model, or its price has changed. Both input and output have to be filled in to take effect; leaving them empty uses the built-in list.

network.title: Internet
network.hint: Turning this off stops everything that needs the internet, API calls included.

mainland.title: Mainland China network
mainland.hint: Fact-checking uses only sources reachable from mainland China (Bing, plus Zhipu when open-web search is on). Turned off, it prefers Wikidata and Wikipedia.

language.title: Language
language.thinNote: The AI answers less accurately in {{language}} than in {{fallback}}. The answer language can be changed on its own, leaving the interface unchanged.

quietIssues.title: Background work
quietIssues.summary_one: {{count}} small background job did not finish recently. Learning is unaffected. Select to see the detail
quietIssues.summary_other: {{count}} small background jobs did not finish recently. Learning is unaffected. Select to see the detail

billing.intro: Every step that costs money has its own switch here, and its spending is tracked separately. This page shows what was actually spent.
billing.estimateIntro: The estimate under each item uses recent actual usage where the feature has been used, and {{scenario}} where it has not; the amount actually spent is listed beside it.
billing.measurementScenario: A learner about three months in: 80 nodes on the knowledge map, one Study mode exchange (question about 40 characters, answer about 600 characters)
billing.estimateUnknownModel: The model in use is not in the built-in price list, so a per-use estimate is not available

diglot.name: Language learning · smart swaps
diglot.hint: The stronger form of language learning: the AI picks the translation that fits the sentence and swaps in a natural phrase where one applies.

chat.name: Chat
chat.hint: The everyday conversation with the AI. This is the core feature and stays on; its cost is listed here as well.

knowledgeTree.name: Knowledge map
knowledgeTree.hint: After each exchange, the AI files what was discussed into the map.

webSearchEvidence.name: Open-web search for evidence (Zhipu)
webSearchEvidence.hint: While this is on, Zhipu's search service is asked to find sources on the open web in addition to Wikidata and Wikipedia, which reaches material an encyclopaedia never recorded. It is billed per call to the Zhipu account; in the browser edition on a mainland-China network it is the only source available. Chinese, English and Swahili only.
webSearchEvidence.disclosure: While this is on, search terms extracted from the question are sent to a search engine. This is a new outbound channel.
webSearchEvidence.keyPlaceholder: Obtain one at open.bigmodel.cn and enter it here
webSearchEvidence.noKey: No key has been entered, so this has no effect for now.

knowledgeEdges.name: Knowledge links
knowledgeEdges.hint: After a new concept is recorded, the AI works out how it connects to what has already been learned.

interest.name: Personal recommendations
interest.hint: The AI notes which topics are of interest and where confusion arises, and uses that to adjust its suggestions; it also identifies which concept a statement such as "I already know this" refers to.

goalPlanning.name: Goal planning
goalPlanning.hint: Once a goal is set, the AI turns it into a list of things to learn.

compareProfileBuild.name: Comparison research (experimental)
compareProfileBuild.hint: For topics outside the occupation directory, the AI searches public sources, assembles the comparison list and checks each source. This takes a few minutes.

compareAlignment.name: Comparison matching
compareAlignment.hint: During a comparison, the AI decides whether your wording and the source's wording refer to the same concept.

teachQuality.name: Teach-back feedback
teachQuality.hint: After an explanation is given to a companion, the AI assesses how it went; the parts explained clearly are recorded.

mapTopicNaming.name: Map naming (experimental)
mapTopicNaming.hint: On the map, the AI names each area that formed on its own.

feedbackLab.name: Recently
feedbackLab.hint: The review panel beside the map, computed entirely from local data.

trailSummary.name: Yesterday's trail
trailSummary.hint: The first time the app is opened each day, the AI records the previous day's learning in one sentence, shown at the top of the "Recently" panel beside the map.

companionChat.name: Companion chat
companionChat.hint: A few classmates come by each day with questions about material learned but untouched for a while.

companionMemory.name: Companion memory
companionMemory.hint: Companions remember what was discussed, and tidy those memories periodically so they stay coherent.

companionScript.name: Companion prep
companionScript.hint: Before an explanation begins, the companion who will listen reads up on the topic so it can follow along.

focusExplain.name: Focus explanations
focusExplain.hint: In focus mode, selecting a word or asking a question produces an explanation.

termMarking.name: Word marking
termMarking.hint: The AI marks the words in each reply that may be unfamiliar; selecting one shows its meaning.

research.panelIntro: Every number on this page was computed by this machine. The research tasks are reviewed and their sources can be checked.
research.offNotice: Research tasks are off: no new task will run. Existing results are kept and can be read or deleted one by one.
research.emptyHint: While the app is idle it computes signed research tasks locally, and the results appear here once they are done.
research.notEnoughData: Not enough data for a conclusion yet
research.deleteConfirmPrompt: A deleted result cannot be restored.
research.settingsRowHint: Runs reviewed research tasks locally and shows the results.
research.closeConfirmWhatItDoes: The research platform runs reviewed, project-signed tasks locally, computes the statistics and displays them.
research.closeConfirmResearchValue: Local aggregate statistics of this kind let researchers study how people learn without collecting personal data.
research.closeConfirmWhatChanges: Once off, no research task will run and this question will not be asked again. Existing results are unaffected and remain in the panel.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.hint: In the browser edition the data is stored in this one browser. Exporting a backup allows the work to continue on another device or in another browser.
backup.replaceWarning: Restoring replaces all current data with the contents of the backup, and what is replaced cannot be recovered. A backup of the current data can be exported first.
backup.exportFailed: This session has no file to export: the browser did not allow this page to store data.
backup.importFailed: That file is not a Breadcrumb backup, and the current data is unchanged. Another file can be tried.
